name: Kynurenine pathway and pyridine nucleotide metabolism
rationale: Members cover tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate catabolism feeding de novo NAD+ synthesis plus nicotinate/NAD+ salvage and turnover; confusables share the NAD core but lack the tryptophan-kynurenine branch and add NADP/CoA/polyamine metabolism.

name: ER unfolded protein response transcription and beta-cell apoptosis
rationale: Members are XBP1/ATF4/ATF6/CREB3 transcriptional UPR outputs and regulation of ER-stress and beta-cell apoptosis; confusables add eIF2-kinase translational control and mitochondrial stress.

name: Incretin and nutrient-sensing GPCR regulation of hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1, GIP, glucagon, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, somatostatin and muscarinic receptor control of insulin/GH secretion via adenylate cyclase; confusables center on adrenergic inhibition, glucagon secretion, beta-cell identity or ghrelin/relaxin.

name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of dolichol-linked precursor supply
rationale: All members are CDGs from defects in dolichol synthesis/phosphorylation (SRD5A3, DOLK), mannose-donor supply and use (PMM2, MPDU1) and LLO flipping (RFT1); confusables are DPM/MPI/PGM1 mannose-donor or ALG glycosyltransferase CDGs.

name: Osteoclast-driven bone remodeling and mineralization regulation
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation, fusion, proliferation and bone resorption together with bone mineralization and remodeling; confusables instead add osteoblast/mesenchymal regulation or IGF responses.

name: Golgi ribbon assembly and mitotic disassembly
rationale: Members all concern Golgi structural organization (ribbon formation, disassembly, pericentriolar stack reorganization); confusables are COPI and Golgi-endosome vesicle trafficking.

name: Semaphorin-3A repulsion and collateral axon sprouting
rationale: Members are Sema3A/CRMP/PAK repulsion, microtubule restraint and regulation of collateral sprouting, nerve branching and regeneration; confusables cover ephrin, netrin or injury-induced axon regeneration.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin, leptin, TPO and IL-6-family (CNTF, LIF, IL-11) receptor signaling via STAT and regulation of body growth; confusables cover erythropoietin, thyroid hormone or GH secretion.

name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA
rationale: All members concern PDH-catalysed pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA and its regulation; confusables are other 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, TCA cycle and carboxylate transport.

name: SLIT-ROBO signaling in axon guidance and negative chemotaxis
rationale: Members are SLIT/ROBO signaling, its Rho GTPase effectors and regulation, commissural/retinal axon guidance and negative chemotaxis; confusables add netrin, ephrin, L1 and DCC guidance.

name: Complement C3 and C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members concern terminal complement effector steps (C3/C5 activation, GZMK-driven activation, opsonization); confusables are the classical and alternative initiation pathways and their regulation.

qualifier: small RNA silencing and mRNA stability
name: Small RNA silencing and mRNA stability control
rationale: Members are miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, ARE-binding protein decay/stabilization, deadenylation, decapping and translational repression; confusables cover nuclear 3'-end processing, splicing, export, NMD and maternal-zygotic transition.

name: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading
rationale: Members are GABA import/reuptake, SLC neurotransmitter transport and synaptic vesicle acidification and loading; confusables are glutamate/aspartate handling, GABA synthesis and monoamine transport.

name: Serotonin, histamine and muscarinic signaling and serotonin turnover
rationale: Members are serotonin, histamine and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling plus serotonin synthesis, uptake and secretion and histamine metabolism; confusables cover nicotinic, purinergic/cAMP-PDE and tachykinin signaling.

name: Glutamate-centred nonessential amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine, proline, glycine, aspartate, 2-oxoglutarate and glyoxylate metabolism and nitrogen use; confusables add glycine conjugation, threonine catabolism, urea cycle or alanine/gluconeogenesis.

name: Regulation of fibrotic connective tissue replacement and ECM assembly
rationale: Members regulate connective tissue replacement, ECM assembly, collagen metabolism, myofibroblast differentiation, fibroblast apoptosis and TGF-beta responses; confusables add fibroblast migration, miRNA processing or elastin/MMP turnover.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are neuroblast/progenitor proliferation and maintenance, forebrain patterning and dopaminergic/photoreceptor differentiation; confusables add cortical neuron migration, radial glia or sympathoadrenal development.

qualifier: sialic acid and mannose with lysosomal catabolism
name: Sialic acid, mannose and GlcNAc metabolism and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members are sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac, GDP-mannose, mannose and GlcNAc metabolism including GNE and NEU1 defects and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown; confusables center on UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, nucleotide-sugar transport, dolichol and N-glycan processing.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: All members are morphogenesis of embryonic head/face/skull and limbs/digits; confusables cover pharyngeal glands and palate, somitogenesis or inner ear.

name: Telomeric DNA replication and t-loop resolution
rationale: Members are semi-conservative telomere replication, telomeric D-loop disassembly and t-circle regulation; confusables cover DNA topology/fork reversal or telomere C-strand synthesis and capping.

name: RabGAP and ARF GTPase control of endocytic and secretory traffic
rationale: Members are Rab/ARF GTPase signaling and RabGAPs with plasma membrane-to-endosome, receptor recycling, constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane targeting; confusables cover endosome-Golgi-lysosome transport, membrane tubulation and Golgi structure/Rab GEFs.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine-SAM cycle
rationale: Members are folate/pterin interconversion and transport with methionine, SAM and homocysteine remethylation (MTR, MTRR, MAT1A, AHCY defects); confusables add methionine salvage, choline/carnitine or selenium metabolism.

name: AP-1 immediate-early gene transcriptional response
rationale: Members are AP-1/FOS-family and NR4A immediate-early programs induced by growth factors, TNF-NFkB and KRAS; confusables cover UV/PI3K responses, ARE-mediated mRNA decay or upstream MAPK kinase regulation.

name: Heme biosynthesis and cytosolic iron-sulfur cluster supply
rationale: Members are porphyrin/heme B and heme A synthesis, hemoglobin synthesis regulation, cytosolic Fe-S assembly and mitochondrial ABC transporters; confusables cover mitochondrial Fe-S assembly, erythrocyte gas transport and iron uptake.

qualifier: integrated stress and unfolded protein responses
name: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response signaling
rationale: Members are eIF2-kinase (GCN2, HRI, PERK) translational control, ER UPR transcription and apoptosis regulation and mitochondrial UPR; confusables cover heat shock, FOXO, ER protein targeting/ERAD and chaperone folding.
